evidence_boundary.stageb_outcome_use: The Stage-B result selects ordering as the next independent research axis only. It does not select or tune a Stage-C score, batch size, neighborhood formula, callback threshold, corpus member, seed, or gate.
evidence_boundary.purpose: One-replicate implementation and mechanism screen for reversible residual-topograph ordering against scored FIFO, residual-only and the derived current unscored FIFO control. It cannot promote a production mechanism.

root_seed_derivation.conversion: unsigned big-endian integer from the first eight digest bytes

case_selection.selection_rule: Two frozen parameter-extreme instances from each of six numerically distinct development families, including close-root target collision, strict guard and opaque multi-target controls. Selection is by the pre-existing factor grid, not by Stage-B outcome.

source_contract.fresh_input: Each case gets one fresh independently seeded D0 maximum matrix; no Stage-A or Stage-B proposal artifact is reused.
source_contract.maximum_prefix: Each case matrix is generated and persisted once with exactly 128 columns.
source_contract.batch_slices: The immutable consecutive slices are 1:16, 17:32, 33:48, 49:64, 65:80, 81:96, 97:112 and 113:128.

mechanism_contract.batch_rule: immutable consecutive source batches 1:16 through 113:128; completely drain one batch before the next batch may enter the logical ledger
mechanism_contract.prescore_visibility: all physical prescores may be computed before local outcomes, but an orderer sees only its current fixed batch and no future-batch score
mechanism_contract.partition_rule: score only canonical-valid observations in opaque public branch-equality partitions; a required missing branch token or any invalid observation remains in a serviced FIFO fallback partition
mechanism_contract.branch_capability_rule: case-level public branch capability distinguishes a branchless case from an observation missing a required token; branch identities are equality-only and are never serialized or ranked
mechanism_contract.normalization_resolution_gate: each coordinate requires max finite prev/next ULP gap at lower, midpoint and upper <= 8eps(Float64) * half_range
mechanism_contract.normalization_gate_failure: if any coordinate fails the gate, all three ordering arms service the complete batch in global immutable FIFO order and record normalization_well_resolved=false
mechanism_contract.covariance_claim_boundary: scale and orthogonal covariance is claimed only for replica pairs in which both boxes pass the normalization-resolution gate
mechanism_contract.fifo_scored_rule: global immutable source order after paying the common prescore cost
mechanism_contract.residual_only_rule: branch-local canonical scaled residual 2-norm order with deterministic round-robin across branch and FIFO-fallback partitions
mechanism_contract.soft_tgo_rule: advance branch-local k-neighborhood topograph minima before the residual order, then drain every remaining member through the same deterministic partition service

work_contract.candidate_batch_ledger: PRESCORE_BATCH with callback cost 16 followed by all 16 whole local attempts in candidate order
work_contract.candidate_prescore_charge: the one physical prescore is charged identically to FIFO_SCORED, RESIDUAL_ONLY and SOFT_TGO
work_contract.fifo_unscored_derivation: reuse the identical FIFO_SCORED local outcomes and source order with prescore callback cost zero; do not execute or select a second local outcome
work_contract.checkpoint_rule: include the longest chronological prefix of atomic prescore batches and whole local attempts whose cumulative observed callbacks do not exceed the threshold; never split or skip a crossing attempt
work_contract.future_batch_score_charge: a future batch contributes neither score nor work before the preceding batch has completely drained in the logical ledger

decision_contract.terminal_identity: all three executed candidate arms and derived FIFO_UNSCORED must drain the same 128 source ordinals and finish with identical assessor answer classes, terminal target sets, safety counts and per-source local outcomes
decision_contract.headroom_rule: a case has ordering headroom exactly when the common terminal answer is safe-full and FIFO_SCORED is not safe-full at callback threshold 600
decision_contract.headroom_signal: at least four cases and three families have ordering headroom, including at least one family outside TANGENT-CIRCLE-LINE and MULTIROOT-WARPED
decision_contract.strict_win_rule: at one common fixed callback threshold SOFT_TGO has strictly more independently assessed distinct valid Gold targets than FIFO_SCORED, RESIDUAL_ONLY and FIFO_UNSCORED, and at no fixed threshold does it have fewer targets or lower safe-full than any control
decision_contract.strict_win_signal: at least two strict-win headroom cases from at least two families, including at least one outside TANGENT-CIRCLE-LINE and MULTIROOT-WARPED
decision_contract.terminal_noninferiority: terminal identity is required case by case; pooled or family means cannot mask a losing or missing case
decision_contract.inconclusive_rule: insufficient headroom is INCONCLUSIVE_NO_HEADROOM and cannot tune this design
decision_contract.favorable_next_step: only a favorable nonpromotional T0 may authorize a separately preregistered multi-replicate Stage-C experiment with the identical mechanism and thresholds
